column1: # push-to-prompt profile map — which Claude Code session each hotkey opens.
# CREATED 2026-09-04 by Sai-mx3 (Engineer agent) per WORK#14 decision D1.
# Edit here, not there. `push-to-prompt profiles` prints the resolved table.
# Columns are TAB separated: key <TAB> dir <TAB> flags <TAB> label
#   key    single character; must match a Raycast command push-to-prompt-<key>.sh
#   dir    session cwd. "~" is expanded. The literal AUTO means "resolve at fire time"
#          (frontmost kitty cwd, else frontmost Finder folder, else ~/code).
#   flags  extra claude flags, space separated. Leave empty for none.
#          NEVER put --bare here: it bills ANTHROPIC_API_KEY instead of the subscription.
#   label  short human name; shows in the notification and the session name.
# A blank flags column still needs its tab, or the label lands in the wrong field.
